scenario_name: Gate Check: Fixed-Term Lease Through March 31 2027
notice_period_required: No unilateral notice permitted before lease expiry
eligibility_and_lawyer_notes: If Tenant 1A & Tenant 1D signed a 12-month fixed-term lease (April 1, 2026 – March 31, 2027) without an express rent-increase reservation clause, Cal. Civ. Code § 827 prohibits any unilateral increase until April 1, 2027.

Because original occupant Tenant 1A continuously resides in Unit 1, Costa-Hawkins § 1954.53(d)(3) and SF Rent Board Rules 6.14/6.15 bar vacancy decontrol and prohibit extra rent for adding/replacing Tenant 1D.

eligibility_and_lawyer_notes: Applies ONLY if Unit 1 is month-to-month with active Rent Increase License. WARNING: An effective date BEFORE February 1, 2027 (<24 full months from Feb 1, 2025) changes the anniversary date and permanently forfeits the skipped Feb 1, 2026 (1.4%) allowance.
